channel.title: News Today — Smart AI News Portal
channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: State Apologizes to Relatives of Prison Guard Slain by IRA
item.description: Irish authorities formally apologized to the relatives of Brian Stack. The prison official was gunned down in Dublin during 1983 and passed away a year and a half later.

item.title: Memories of Childhood Durga Puja Celebrations
item.description: For the author, early Durga Puja events in Sirajganj were defined by profound joy, colorful lights, new outfits, drumbeats, and bustling fairgrounds.

item.title: Australia Faces Possible Innings Defeat After Losing 13 Wickets
item.description: Australia experienced the rare loss of 13 wickets within a single day. This marks the first occurrence of such an event since the Sydney Ashes Test during the 1954-55 season.

item.title: Intern Doctors Strike at Rajshahi Medical College Disrupts Care
item.description: Intern physicians launched a work stoppage centered on five demands. These include better medical supplies, enhanced security, restricted visitor access, and a functioning casualty unit.

item.title: Waymo Begins Autonomous Vehicle Services at Las Vegas Airport
item.description: Travelers can now request rides to and from Terminals 1 and 3. Passenger loading and unloading take place within designated driverless transport zones.

item.title: Missing Woman Found Dead in Pond Near Home with Bound Limbs
item.description: Locals discovered a body floating in a pond close to Sushil Das's residence on Wednesday afternoon. The housewife had been reported missing for four days.

item.title: Moscow Expresses Willingness for Ukraine Conflict Negotiations
item.description: Russia stated it is prepared to restart discussions with the United States and Ukraine. This declaration followed a meeting in St. Petersburg between Vladimir Putin and US envoy Steve Witkoff.

item.title: New Newsletter Examines Wellness Gadgets and Longevity Treatments
item.description: A weekly newsletter examines emerging health gadgets and treatments marketed for longevity. It reviews various products claiming to promote youthfulness and vitality.

item.title: Burnham Outlines Strategy to Eliminate Fixed Gas Standing Charges
item.description: A proposal has been put forward by Burnham to remove fixed standing charges from gas bills. However, the prime minister offered minimal specifics, prompting concerns about transferring these expenses to per-unit rates.

item.title: Biman Bangladesh Airlines Resumes Riyadh and Dammam Flights
item.description: Biman will restart its Riyadh flights on 25 October following a two-week suspension. Additionally, operations on the Dammam route are scheduled to resume earlier, starting on 22 October.

item.title: Bagmara Union Parishad Member Detained With Disability Allowance SIMs
item.description: A local council member in Bagmara upazila of Rajshahi was caught with a dozen SIM cards meant for disability allowances. Locals confronted him and subsequently handed the SIM cards over to the union parishad chairman.

item.title: Four Nations Form New Military Partnership Pact
item.description: Pakistan, Turkiye, Qatar, and Indonesia have finalized an agreement to strengthen their defense collaboration. This follows the signing of the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement by Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkiye in August.

item.title: Australia Faces Severe Defeat and Scrutiny in South Africa Test
item.description: Following a disastrous fourth-day display in the second Test against South Africa, Australia is staring at a potential loss. Several players now face intense pressure regarding their professional futures.

item.title: Bangladesh Invites Major Chinese Financial Institutions to Invest
item.description: During a Tuesday event in Beijing, Bangladeshi officials urged top Chinese banks to expand operations into Bangladesh. The gathering included Investment Authority chairman Ashik Chowdhury, Ambassador Md Nazmul Islam, and China Exim Bank Vice President Wang Kang.

item.title: Road Accidents Claim Nearly 8,000 Children's Lives in Bangladesh
item.description: Between 2020 and September 2026, traffic accidents killed 7,963 children nationwide, with over thirty percent struck while commuting to school. Three-wheelers were responsible for a significant portion of these pedestrian and transit fatalities.

item.title: French President Macron Conducts Unannounced Visit to Riyadh
item.description: During his regional tour of the Gulf, French leader Emmanuel Macron made an unexpected stop in Riyadh. While there, he held a meeting with the Saudi Crown Prince to discuss solidarity.

item.title: Forensics analyze materials recovered from suspected IED explosion site
item.description: Investigators found questionable objects inside a bag at the incident location. Conflicting accounts from victims and discovered wiring have prompted concerns.

item.title: দায় কার: সৌদিতে ফাঁসি ও রাশিয়ায় যুদ্ধ নিয়ে আলোচনা
item.description: রামরুর নির্বাহী পরিচালক তাসনিম সিদ্দিকীর বিশ্লেষণে এবং রাহীদ এজাজের সঞ্চালনায় সৌদি আরবে মৃত্যুদণ্ড ও রাশিয়ায় বাংলাদেশিদের যুদ্ধ যাওয়ার বিষয়টির দায় নিয়ে আলোচনা হয়েছে।

item.title: সৌদি আরবে দুই বাংলাদেশির মৃত্যুদণ্ড ও অন্যান্য প্রধান খবর
item.description: গোপন নথির তথ্যের ভিত্তিতে সৌদি আরবে দুই বাংলাদেশির মৃত্যুদণ্ড কার্যকর হওয়ার খবর জানা গেছে। পাশাপাশি সনাতন ধর্মাবলম্বীদের শারদীয় দুর্গোৎসবের সমাপ্তি এবং অন্যান্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ঘটনা তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।

item.title: Greek educators and students protest living expenses and housing
item.description: Educators and pupils marched through Athens to oppose soaring living expenses, expensive fuel, student housing shortages, and poor school conditions.

item.title: Tirupati experiences heavy rainfall due to Tamil Nadu low pressure
item.description: A low-pressure system developing off the coast of Tamil Nadu has triggered heavy precipitation in the Tirupati region.

item.title: Karnataka transmen cricket team faces monetary hurdles before games
item.description: A cricket squad composed of transmen from Karnataka is struggling with financial limitations ahead of competing in a national-level tournament.

item.title: শারদীয় দুর্গোৎসবের প্রেক্ষাপটে বাংলা মধ্যযুগীয় সাহিত্য চর্চা
item.description: ১৯ অক্টোবর রাতে অনুষ্ঠিত পাঠচক্রে কবিকঙ্কণ মুকুন্দরাম চক্রবর্তীর কাব্যের কালকেতু ও ফুল্লরা উপাখ্যান নিয়ে আলোচনা করা হয়। এতে মধ্যযুগের সমাজ ও লোকজীবন ফুটিয়ে তোলা হয়েছে।

item.title: ভেপিং ছাড়লেও স্থায়ী ক্ষতি হয়েছে, জানালেন মার্কিন গায়িকা সেলেনা
item.description: অতিরিক্ত নিকোটিন গ্রহণের ফলে কণ্ঠস্বর বদলে যাওয়ায় ভেপিং ছেড়ে দিয়েছেন মার্কিন তারকা সেলেনা গোমেজ। তিনি মনে করেন এই অভ্যাসের কারণে তাঁর কণ্ঠের যে ক্ষতি হয়েছে তা অপূরণীয়।

item.title: Eight Rescued After Cargo Ship Sinks Near Beypore
item.description: The cargo vessel MSV Jesus Heart sank off the Beypore coast during a voyage to Lakshadweep's Kavaratti. All eight crew members on board were successfully rescued following the Tuesday night accident.

item.title: Police raid senior official's residence yielding minimal alcohol
item.description: A late-night raid by high-ranking police at a senior official's home led to 85 arrests and widespread discussion on Tuesday. Officers themselves expressed surprise when the three-hour operation recovered only one full bottle of alcohol alongside three partially filled ones.

item.title: Just Eat removes flawed AI images and halts tool rollout
item.description: Following online mockery regarding erroneous food pictures, Just Eat issued an apology. A company representative stated that faulty artificial intelligence graphics are being deleted and the feature rollout is on hold.

item.title: PHP creators release patches following widespread security panic
item.description: Global government warnings followed the discovery of flaws affecting numerous websites using PHP. Creators of the programming language are now pressing users to apply patches right away.

item.title: Minnesota tribe lowers Clay County casino land bid to 80 acres
item.description: Addressing worries regarding infrastructure, water, taxes, and traffic, the White Earth Nation decreased its Clay County trust application from nearly 300 down to 80 acres. The casino project currently awaits a final decision.

item.title: Macron travels to Riyadh for talks on Houthi attacks and fuel
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron made an unexpected trip to Riyadh on Wednesday. The visit aimed to express backing for the kingdom amid Houthi strikes while securing fuel imports to address domestic pressures.

item.title: San Francisco housing co-op secures funds for 2,400 new units
item.description: Freedom West Homes secured financial backing for a redevelopment plan to construct 2,400 residences. The initiative protects current cooperative shareholders from displacement by keeping them in place.

item.title: US official meets Indian business leaders during refinery tour
item.description: Rubio met with Chandrasekaran and Adani while touring the Jamnagar refinery operated by Reliance. The meetings occur as the United States and India aim to strengthen strategic and commercial cooperation in energy, technology, and manufacturing.

item.title: First palm cockatoo chick hatches in Australian artificial hollow
item.description: Conservationists on the Cape York Peninsula built 29 artificial tree hollows to address a shortage of natural nesting spaces. A palm cockatoo chick recently left one of these man-made cavities, marking a conservation success.

item.title: Congress politicians face criticism for showing palapitta during Dasara
item.description: Members of the Congress party are facing scrutiny following their display of the palapitta bird throughout recent Dasara celebrations.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi questions timing of Epstein and Puri photo publication
item.description: Rahul Gandhi has questioned U.S. motives regarding the release of a photo involving Hardeep Singh Puri and Jeffrey Epstein. Other opposition figures also challenged Puri's explanation of these encounters during Marco Rubio's Mumbai visit.

item.title: Examining untouchability, legal standards, and notions of purity
item.description: This overview examines how Indian legislation defines untouchability and how the Supreme Court has evaluated concepts of purity. It also reviews a Rajasthan High Court decision and the specifics surrounding a Haldwani ritual.

item.title: Champions League Live: Real Madrid faces RB Leipzig
item.description: Get real-time updates and lineup announcements from the live text coverage featuring stars like Bellingham and Mbappe.

item.title: বাজার জুড়েই নিম্নমানের বাল্ব, বিপাকে ক্রেতারা
item.description: কম দামে এলইডি কেনার সময় ক্রেতারা প্রায়শই মান পরীক্ষা করেন না, যা ঝুঁকি বাড়ায়। সঠিক আলো ও স্থায়িত্ব নিশ্চিত করতে মান সনদ যাচাই করার পরামর্শ দেওয়া হয়েছে।

item.title: Champions League Live: Bayern Munich meets Arsenal
item.description: Follow pre-match analysis, team news, and play-by-play text commentary for this league-stage fixture.

item.title: Delhi performer at 69 maintains Ramleela self-immolation act
item.description: Ram Prasad Tiwari, aged 69, has performed a fifty-foot fire jump into water for almost five decades. He travels to multiple locations to execute this stunt during the Ramleela festivities.

item.title: Factors driving ongoing demonstrations across Portugal
item.description: This report examines the underlying causes and grievances fueling recent public demonstrations in Portugal.

item.title: Taiwanese prosecutors indict five men over attack plot against comedian
item.description: Authorities in New Taipei have indicted five individuals accused of accepting funds from a mainland Chinese intermediary to target comedian Huang Yi-hao with a vehicle attack following his satirical remarks about Beijing leadership.

item.title: Two individuals injured following suspected improvised explosive device blast
item.description: An explosion resulting from a suspected improvised explosive device has left two people injured. Local authorities are investigating the incident.

item.title: VR fitness application Supernatural relaunches in Meta Horizon Store
item.description: Following a spinoff, the virtual reality fitness game Supernatural is returning with an early access preview. The platform plans to introduce numerous remastered sessions, musical updates, and VR workouts.

item.title: Canadian liquefied natural gas expansion draws criticism over human rights
item.description: As Canada increases its liquefied natural gas export capacity, opponents are expressing alarm regarding human rights violations associated with primary corporate backers.

item.title: Telangana records over ₹2,000 crore in liquor sales amid Dasara festival
item.description: Liquor depot transactions in Telangana increased by 37 percent compared to the previous year, surpassing ₹2,000 crore over a 19-day period. Retailers heavily stocked inventory ahead of the festival, with single-day supplies reaching ₹303.40 crore on October 19.

item.title: Indian athletes prepare for October 22 events at the Asian Para Games
item.description: Having secured 62 medals so far, the Indian contingent aims to boost its count on Thursday. Para-athletes, including Dilip Gavit, will compete to improve the nation's standing, having previously secured 14 gold medals.

item.title: Germany elevates military sabotage alert status after drone discovery
item.description: Germany has increased its military threat level for Russian sabotage to the second-highest tier. This decision follows the discovery of an explosive drone near the Wunstorf air base, prompting ongoing security investigations.

item.title: Australia Struggles Against Jansen Bowling Attack in Gqeberha
item.description: Australian batsmen faltered during the fourth morning session in Gqeberha, reaching lunch at 69 for six wickets down. The team still requires 157 additional runs to avoid being forced to follow on.

item.title: চীনা প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলো ইপিজেডে সর্বোচ্চ বিনিয়োগকারী দেশের তালিকায় শীর্ষে
item.description: ১৯৮৩ সালে চট্টগ্রামে প্রথম ইপিজেড চালুর পর থেকে বেপজার অধীনে বর্তমানে আটটি ইপিজেড ও দুটি অর্থনৈতিক অঞ্চল চালু রয়েছে। এর মধ্যে চীনা কোম্পানিগুলো বিনিয়োগে প্রধান অবস্থানে রয়েছে।

item.title: FSSAI Questions Nestle and Zydus Over Ad Claims
item.description: Food safety authorities in India have directed Nestle and Zydus Wellness to submit scientific evidence. The notice concerns promotional statements made about their food items.

item.title: ইউসুফ পাঠানের জমির নোটিশ ও রাজনৈতিক দল বদল
item.description: ২০২৪ সালে তৃণমূলের টিকিটে লোকসভা সংসদ সদস্য নির্বাচিত হওয়ার পর গুজরাটে জমির দখল নিয়ে নোটিশ পান ইউসুফ পাঠান। পরবর্তীতে বিজেপির জোটে যোগ দেওয়ায় তিনি ওই জমি উপহার হিসেবে পাওয়ার কথা জানা গেছে।

item.title: প্রতিমা বিসর্জনে শেষ হলো দুর্গোৎসব
item.description: প্রতিমা বিসর্জনের আনুষ্ঠানিকতা সম্পন্ন করার মাধ্যমে হিন্দু সম্প্রদায়ের প্রধান ধর্মীয় উৎসব দুর্গোৎসবের পাঁচ দিনের কার্যক্রম শেষ হয়েছে। দেবী দুর্গাকে বিদায় জানানোর মধ্য দিয়ে এই উৎসবের সমাপ্তি ঘটে।

item.title: Agrivoltaics Potential Highlighted by Minister Joshi
item.description: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi stated that utilizing ten percent of appropriate land for agrivoltaics could satisfy electricity needs by 2050. He added that authorities plan to integrate an agrivoltaics segment into the PM-Kusum initiative.

item.title: চীনের হলুদ নদীর জলপ্রপাতে সাংস্কৃতিক প্রতিযোগিতা
item.description: চীনের ঐতিহ্যবাহী হলুদ নদীর হুকৌ জলপ্রপাতে জাঁকজমকপূর্ণ আয়োজনে অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে ‘ইয়েলো রিভার ক্যানটাটা’ সাংস্কৃতিক প্রতিযোগিতার চূড়ান্ত পর্ব। এই আয়োজনে অংশ নিয়েছে তিনশ শিল্পী দল।

item.title: WWII Uranium Study Evaluates Nazi Nuclear Progress
item.description: Analysis of historical uranium and heavy water provides new data on the Nazi regime's proximity to developing a nuclear reactor during the Second World War.

item.title: Parades Held to Honor Fallen Police Officers
item.description: Memorial parades took place to honor deceased law enforcement personnel. Officials and citizens gathered to pay tribute to the fallen officers.

item.title: Boulter Secures Quick Victory at Japan Open
item.description: Katie Boulter advanced to the quarter-finals of the Japan Open. She defeated Viktorija Golubic in a match lasting under sixty minutes.

item.title: CJP Leaders Released From Tihar Jail
item.description: Following seven days in judicial custody, a Delhi special executive magistrate court ordered the release of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka from Tihar Jail. Upon exiting, Das stated that truth triumphed, and Ranka raised a revolutionary slogan.

item.title: Indian Team Faces New Zealand Conditions
item.description: The Indian squad prepares for adaptation challenges during their upcoming matches in New Zealand. Their previous T20I tour in 2022 featured a rain-affected tie in Napier and a series victory in the sole completed fixture.
